# Snow puff, three lumps. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Snow --base-color 0.769 0.941 0.761 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name A --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.12 --location 0 0 0.12
material assign Snow
add mesh ico-sphere --name B --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.09 --location 0.12 0.04 0.08
material assign Snow
add mesh ico-sphere --name C --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.08 --location -0.1 -0.05 0.07
material assign Snow
select all
active A
join
rename A Puff
shade flat
export puff.glb
